text: Constant Crashing issue — Crashing constantly for last 6 months, please fix. The app is beneficial to the elderly to help us stay organized. Please fix crashing issue. I have successfully used this app for years and love it normally. Right now it sucks royal lemons.
Manage your meds❣️ — I just love this app…I had such a time keeping up with my med, being a Senior Citizen and having more med… this app is amazing!! 🤩

I needed this… — My daughter got me to use this app, I’m so bad at taking my meds and this helps me to push to take it. It also helps to keep track of taking it which I’m bad at. Getting old is not easy and we forget , but with a little help especially like this app, being old ain’t so bad

Good app but needs enhancements — The app does a great job at what it’s supposed to do - track complex medication schedules, dosages, etc. I love that it allows me to customize a schedule - 2 pills for 10 days, then 1 pill for 10 days, etc. Some things for improvements and enhancements: - Stop sending reminder notifications once the meds have been marked taken on any device. My husband will mark something taken, I’ll get reminders on my device, and log in and see they’re already marked. There’s a disconnect between taken status and notifications when using multiple devices/users, but we share caretaking responsibilities. - Allow more notification customizations - I keep getting notifications to add appointments or doctors, but we don’t use the app for that. Even with premium, I’d like to opt out of some types of notifications, or set it for med reminders only. - setting up multiple users/caretakers was not intuitive- it took us a few tries. I wish that was a little easier and facilitated more than two caretakers for a person.  - allow message management in the “updates” module.  I can’t delete them or mark them read without opening each, and that little red dot is not enjoyable.

Great app, except…. — My son recently had his tonsils removed, so this app has been amazing to track his medication. However, when adding a tracker, it’s only available in Celsius. If Fahrenheit was available…it would be 5 stars.

Learning — Learning to use the app very slowly.   It can be a little hard to navigate/ set up for us seniors.   Anyway now I have Donald Trump telling me to take my meds I’m doing so much better.    If I could only remember to take my phone everywhere I go…………
Fantastic for my Mother!! — Thank you so much for this app!! I use it to track my mother’s medication. She has Alzheimer’s so it helps me to keep up. Only wish that there were more options for notes.

Perfect for Seniors — Perfect for this 74 year old.  Recently I had a spinal fusion surgery and am taking the over twenty pills I take daily. Additionally the meds I take cause memory loss, Having both my wife and myself monitoring everything  assures me I will get the meds on time.  100% love this app.

Title: Essential for Family Caregiving – Needs a "Multi-Caregiver Signature" Feature — Medisafe is an excellent app for medication management, but it could be a game-changer for families who share the responsibility of caring for elderly parents.
Currently, when multiple family members (caregivers) are linked to one patient profile as 'Medfriends,' it is difficult to track exactly who administered a dose. We often face confusion or duplicate questions in our family chats.
I strongly suggest adding a 'Multi-Caregiver Signature' or 'Team Logging' feature. The app should explicitly record and display the specific name of the member who confirmed each dose. This would ensure clear accountability, seamless coordination, and much-needed peace of mind for family teams. Thank you for a great tool!"

Great idea, bad app! — Been looking for an app that can help my mom track her medication and allow me to see updates on it since she has early dementia and if she forgets a dose I can remind her. I was hopeful this app would work for that, because the system is “program” for it. However, this features are a mess! The meds list suddenly disappeared from the “friends” profile not allowing me to see if she take it or not, I doubled check her app to make sure there were still meds listed and yes, they were showing on her profile yet not in mine. So it wont work for what I need.

What a great app! — This app has been a godsend in helping my family member to remember to take some important meds twice a day. It is also great for me as their medifriend. I no longer have to call and nag them near as often. It gives me peace of mind, to just glance at the app and see that they’ve taken their meds. The slight hiccup is that the app is not very consistent about when it will alert me that they’ve not taken their meds at the designated time. Sometimes it alerts at 45 minutes past the time, sometimes it alerts at 2 hours, but worse is when there’s no alert at all.

I love this app — My husband just had surgery and was put on quite a few medications that needed to be taken at different times and different amounts. This app has helped me stay on track with ease. I can’t imagine trying to manage his medication without it!
Good app, but setup can be challenging — Best app I’ve found for scheduling my wife’s medication & getting reminders. Setup though keeps challenging me. It is still worth a high rating.

Caregivers beware — My wife and I started using this app after a recent surgery to help track her medications. We primarily decided to use the app so I could make sure everything was being taken on time and at the right dosage. There have been consistent issues with refreshing to show that meds have been taken (I often have to switch between my profile and hers to show updates). The more serious issue is that multiple medications of hers stopped showing up on my app, but not hers, and did not even reappear after I tried refreshing by switching between profiles. We are both on the most updated iOS and I have tried uninstalling and reinstalling the app to no avail. She had to remove these medications and re add them before I could see them again.

Crashes — I like the concept of what this app intends to do. However, it locks up daily for both the person taking the pills as well as the care giver. I've tried to resolve it with customer service without results. I'm changing to an alternate app.
Very good — This is an excellent app.  I use it to help a friend with dementia and also use it for my meds. I do wish it would sync with Apple iPad and iPhone.

Overall good, could use some encouragement — We use this app with my mom after recommendations from several friends. On the whole, it’s great! She sometimes has trouble adjusting the time if she takes the pills at a slightly different time than scheduled, but we can at least see that she took it. One area for improvement: it would be great if there was some celebration when all the meds are done for the day! Just a few little fireworks, or a trophy - she would appreciate that.

Calendar request — I wish the calendar would scroll from Saturday to Sunday in the next week. When you scroll to the next week, it goes to the next Saturday. It should go to the next day. Dementia patients and other mentally impaired patients could get confused. It was always a point of stress for my husband who had a brain tumor. Otherwise the app is wonderful. Literally a life saver when you have medicine to keep up with for several people in your household!

Great App — My dad was discharged from the hospital and came home with so many medications. I was trying to organize and help my mom with his schedule, then my brother found this great app. This app made our life much easier to take care of my dad’s medications. 
Thank you so much 😃

Organized Multitasking at its finest! — I’m not sure I’ve ever tried a different medication app before, but if I did then I’m convinced that this is the only app I’ll need for my meds, that of a loved one with weekly reports on our compliance… I’m not sure it gets better than this! I LOVE the Medisafe app. I’ve recommended it to more people than I know, especially those juggling additional health-related responsibilities.

— It's not easy to add a MedFriend. When it is successful, they only get notified when I skip medicine, not when I take it. There's no setting to switch it to notifying when I do take medicine, either. Also, you can't send tracker numbers unless you send a spreadsheet. The graph is nice, but I just want to send my family my glucose numbers.

— I've been using this app for probably over a year now. I don't utilize all of the features. I just use the main feature of reminders a couple times a day. I like that I can completely customize how the reminders work - what names I want to put into the reminder, what color/form to make the icon, what time for it to pop up, being able to snooze it for multiple lengths of time.... I wish that my husband and I could BOTH have access to marking my son's medications.

— I've had a stroke and can't remember much. this app fixes that problem! now I never miss my pills, medisafe keeps track of my stock and reminds me when I'm getting low before I run out. I can't say enough good things about this app! Well worth what I pay for it each month. it even tracks my blood pressure, insomnia, depression, anxiety, and a ton of other ailments. it also puts all my tracking into one easy report you been print or email to your DR each month. there's even a place to make notes.

— Easy to use! Set up (adding meds) is a snap. You can choose the generic or brand name of the drug, enter the RX number and choose the exact size, mg, shape and color of the medicine. This is such a help for my elderly Mom who only knows "the big blue one" when it comes to drug identification. I was able to track for refills, set reminders (which includes the sound of a pill bottle being shaken- well done!) and more. The interface is intuitive and navigation very efficient.
1 person found this review helpful

— My mom takes 20+ different medications each day which is a struggle to do accurately and on schedule when I'm physically present, and nearly impossible when I'm not. This app not only reminds her exactly what to take AND at the appropriate time (soooooo much better and more discreet than using 6+ daily alarms that she dismisses and forgets to actually take), but also contacts me if she's over 30min late on confirming any dose so I can check in. Still working on getting notifications to show up on her Fitbit Versa so she gets reminded even when her phone isn't nearby, but an otherwise fantastic app that I've recommended to many others!!

— I'm finding an issue. My children are older now.. my daughter and I take the same medication. When I click my reminder to refill I can't tell if it's mine or hers. It just shows the medication name and med details.. no name. Is there a fix I'm missing?? I've been using this app for over ten years. This is something that's been an issue though.. **I have different dependents, that part is easy. But when I get the pop-up reminder to refill it doesn't tell me if it's for me or her.

— I love the reminder & that you can snooze or reschedule it. The downside is there is no family version. I need to be able to view, edit, & print my family members meds all on the same app from my own phone. That would make it easier if I had to take one of them to the hospital or doctors office. Another app I used had that feature, but they since discontinued the app. It would also help is there was a section to list Surgeries, shots, & graphs for blood pressure, weight etc...
1 person found this review helpful

— I had major surgery requiring several meds throughout the day after I left the hospital. This app was great to log it all and get reminders. The 'medfriend' option was useful too. My husband could keep track from his phone and make sure I hadn't missed a dose while sleeping. Overall, very easy to use. The only feature I wish it had was some way to let you know the next time a medication is available to be taken when it's as needed and not on a specific schedule.

— I have never seen an app that can't handle a simple reminder. I love the idea of this app - but the inability for both caregiver and user to be involved with managing case and care, is ridiculous. What is far worse that that, though, is that this app promises to remind you to take your medication and then doesn't. First, weirdly, I would only get the notifications if I were connected to my PC at the time, then they stopped all together. My medications are time sensitive - this is dangerous! 😡

— I'm new to the app but so far, it's been a perfect addition as I become more involved in the care of my parents And my mother in law. It allows me to keep up with each of their medication lists as it changes, and allows them to add notes to tell me if there are things I should know about the dosage. I've added all their doctors and their contact info. It's become a helpful One Stop place for me to care for everyone in my family. love it!!

Built a free pill reminder app for people managing multiple medications — no subscription, works offline

My parents take 7 medications a day. After Medisafe went subscription this year and capped free users at 2 medications, I couldn't find a good cross-platform replacement — so I built one.
DoseWise: unlimited meds, daily reminders, mark taken from the notification, no account required, no data collection. One-time unlock ($4.99) for PDF export to bring to doctor appointments.
Launching soon — waitlist here if interested: [https://tally.so/r/9q2Y2K](https://tally.so/r/9q2Y2K)
Pill Reminder App Recommendation — The first one on that list is "Medisafe" - and is free (both iOS and Android)Medisafe has been around for almost a decade. I'll check out Medisafe.
